task: Unseen host genome -> rank the same known 94-phage library for source MLC positivity
development_status: New ranking analysis on an already inspected cohort; no independent confirmation or model promotion
candidate_rule: All 94 named library phages, fixed before evaluation; score every candidate, including pairs without labels; never filter by held-out positives
label_rule: Reconcile source MLC with the registered binary subset; missing MLC is unknown, not zero. Primary metrics require every panel label for a host.
tie_policy: Exact expectation over uniform within-score-tie permutations; random and constant global prevalence are identical expectations
denominators: Report complete-panel host coverage, all complete-panel hosts and eligible complete-panel hosts with >=1 observed positive; no-positive hosts have Hit/MRR=0 and undefined Recall
primary: Grouped-host test, host-macro all-complete-host Hit@2: host_4mer_logistic minus train-only phage_prevalence. Other contrasts and every sensitivity are descriptive; no tuning or independent confirmation.
scenarios: leave each published Clermont phylogroup out, purging any touching near-clonal host components from train

estimator.rule: Refit the unchanged host model in each scenario; unique train hosts only for preprocessing; no model selection

not_run.GenoPHI: No aligned full-panel strain-held-out scores available; official 25x25 demo is a separate cohort
not_run.Omnii: No Omnii weights/scores; this is an analogous task definition, not numerical reproduction
not_run.Evo2: No aligned strain-level embeddings or GPU server access; published species scores are a different task

limitations: Already inspected development cohort and a fixed source assay; not an independent release holdout.
Host FASTA bytes and canonical assembly identities are reverified; near-clonal groups remain the previously frozen groups, not newly reconstructed.
Random strain splitting may share related host groups with fitting; overlaps are reported.

Clermont phylogroups are published metadata, not reconstructed clades or the Omnii 37-strain holdout. All observed groups are reported, including small panels; intervals condition on each chosen group and fixed library.
Missing-panel hosts are excluded as whole hosts and counted. No claim for unevaluable hosts or unmeasured candidates.
Named phages include exact sequence duplicates; library is fixed by source IDs, with no phenotype-based merging.
Scores are uncalibrated MLC positivity scores; Hit@K describes finding at least one source-positive individual phage, not cocktail efficacy or clinical benefit.
All contrasts are descriptive development intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim or automatic retraining.
Simple host composition with known-phage identity; not a foundation model or explicit host-phage mechanistic model.
Regularization is fixed at C=0.1 from the prior study; concatenating features changes effective regularization. No best representation is selected for release.

representation.genome: 136 strand-canonical 4-mer frequencies; count within contigs; skip any ambiguous window; normalize by valid windows; no test-fitted vocabulary or statistics
representation.annotations: Unchanged 137 defense counts plus four surface categories
representation.hybrid: Concatenate genome frequencies and unchanged annotations; no feature selection
representation.models: Separate fixed logistic classifier per known phage; no unseen-phage capability
representation.preprocessing: Standardize numeric features over unique train hosts only; categories from train only; unchanged Beta(1,1) fallback for single-class phages
representation.label_independence: Extract each host separately; verify source bytes and canonical assembly identity against frozen manifest; never concatenate contigs or delete ambiguity codes

numerical_environment.rule: Use inherited package lock for numerical reproduction; actual interpreter and package versions are recorded, not silently substituted.
